name: Hebrew
source: Wikidata Lexemes — lemmas of lexemes whose dct:language is wd:Q9288 (Hebrew), retrieved via the Wikidata Query Service
licence_evidence: Wikidata content, including Lexeme data, is released under CC0 1.0 (a public-domain dedication). Retrieved 2026-08-20 via https://query.wikidata.org/sparql. CC0 imposes no attribution or share-alike obligation on a redistributing MIT-licensed product.
processing: SPARQL: SELECT DISTINCT ?lemma WHERE { ?l dct:language wd:Q9288 ; wikibase:lemma ?lemma } paged in batches of 10000.
Kept entries matching ^[א-ת]{2,}$, which removes vocalised (niqqud) spellings, single letters, and anything carrying punctuation or Latin characters.
comment: Niqqud forms are deliberately excluded: Hebrew is typed without vowel points in practice, so a
vocalised lemma would never match what a user produces on the keyboard.
Rejected alternative: eyaler/hebrew_wordlists, the best-known Hebrew list, derives from Hspell and
is AGPL-3.0. It is a copyleft licence and was not used, per FR-008a.
